source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of semiconductors with Quick Check 31.1 and derived answers (PDF 221).

blocks.text: Semiconductors aise substances hain jo sirf special conditions (khaas halaat) mein electricity conduct karte (guzarte) hain, aur light (roshni), heat (garmi) aur voltage se sensitive hain (asar lete hain). Isi wajah se yeh modern electronics mein bohat ahem hain. Conductor aur semiconductor mein farq yeh hai ke semiconductor mein guzarne wale current ko zarurat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai. Sab se aam semiconductor silicon hai; yeh bohat effective hai aur abundant (bohat zyada milta) hai, is liye microchips aur solar panels mein use hota hai. Mobile ka SIM card silicon chip aur kuch chhote components, jaise copper connectors, se bana hota hai. Silicon device mein data conduct, store aur process karne ke kaam aata hai. Aik aur ahem semiconductor gallium arsenide (GaAs) hai, jo wireless communication, maslan 5G internet devices, mein use hota hai. Gallium nitride (GaN) apni advanced (behtar) conductivity ki wajah se electric cars ki fast charging mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: i. Power lines (bijli ki taaron) par ceramics insulators ke taur par kyun use hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Porcelain jaise ceramics electricity nahi guzarte, is liye current taar se pole (khambe) tak nahi pohanchta. Yeh hard, heat se mehfooz aur chemically inert bhi hain, is liye bahar dhoop aur barish mein bhi der tak chalte hain.

blocks.prompt: ii. Microchips aur solar panels ke liye silicon kyun pasand kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Silicon bohat achha semiconductor hai jis ka current control ho sakta hai, aur yeh abundant (bohat zyada milta) hai.

blocks.prompt: iii. Composite materials mein reinforcement agents kya dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada strength (mazbooti); matrix unhein apni jagah pakre rakhta hai.

items: Semiconductors special conditions mein electricity guzarte hain; in ka current control ho sakta hai.
Si: microchips, solar panels, SIM card; GaAs: 5G; GaN: electric cars ki fast charging.
